name: sign-out with an empty outbox still waits for a finish; Keep purges account rows and cursors, retains device work, leaves the replica dormant and starts an anon replica
sign-out with unsent entries and no choice releases holds and answers their count
Keep leaves the unsent entries in the dormant replica
Discard deletes the replica and ends its entries discarded
acked entries are not unsent, and a question left unanswered resolves nothing: they stay acked
the finish resolves acked entries: the server holds them
a Discard pinned to entries that changed since the question is asked again with the new count
Keep covers every entry: an autosave between the question and the Keep does not ask again, and the dormant replica keeps both
an existing anon replica becomes the active one
an explicit discard deletes a dormant replica and ends its entries discarded
